name: United States
description: The US is the top destination for international tech talent. H-1B is the most common work visa for specialty occupations.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in specialty occupation, employer sponsorship required, annual lottery cap of 85,000
timeline: File LCA → File I-129 → Lottery → Approval → Start date Oct 1

name: Canada
description: Canada is increasingly popular for tech workers seeking an alternative to the US. Global Talent Stream offers fast-track processing.
requirements: Job offer from Canadian employer, LMIA or TN for US/Mexico citizens
timeline: LMIA application → Work permit → PR pathway

name: United Kingdom
description: The UK Skilled Worker visa replaced Tier 2 post-Brexit. No cap on numbers, employer-sponsored with points-based system.
requirements: Job offer from licensed sponsor, meet salary threshold (£26,200 min), English language
timeline: Employer gets CoS → Apply online → Biometrics → Decision

name: Germany
description: Germany's EU Blue Card is ideal for highly-qualified professionals. Growing tech hub with many English-friendly companies.
requirements: University degree recognized in Germany, job offer above €56,400/year (MINT: €43,992)
timeline: Get job offer → Visa application → Entry → Register residence → Blue Card

name: Netherlands
description: The Netherlands is a top European tech hub. Knowledge Migrant Permit (LTSVP) offers fast 2-week processing for recognized sponsors.
requirements: Salary above €5,008/month (2025), recognized IND sponsor employer
timeline: Employer applies → IND decision → MVV → Entry → Residence permit

name: Australia
description: Australia actively recruits skilled tech workers. TSS subclass 482 allows work for up to 4 years with a path to PR.
requirements: Skills assessment, employer sponsorship, meet TSMIT salary threshold
timeline: Employer nominated → Nominate position → Visa application → Grant

name: Singapore
description: Singapore's Employment Pass is for professional, managerial, and executive jobs. No annual cap, fast processing.
requirements: Fixed monthly salary of at least S$5,600, recognized qualifications
timeline: Apply online → Assessment → Approval → Card issuance

name: Ireland
description: Ireland is a major European tech hub hosting EU HQs of Google, Meta, Apple, and more. Critical Skills Permit fast-tracks talented workers.
requirements: Job in eligible occupation, salary €38,000+ (Critical Skills: €32,000+), job offer from Irish employer
timeline: Job offer → Permit application → Entry clearance → IRP registration
